name: md-atlas
description: Search international medical-device companies, people, devices, certificates, regulatory documents and UDI codes.

interface.longDescription: MD Atlas lets you look up the medical-device market from ChatGPT. It covers companies registered for the European market, wherever they are based. Search manufacturers, authorised representatives and importers. Check a manufacturer's certificates and their notified body. Find the people a company declares, such as its PRRC. Look up devices, UDI codes and their variants. Find SSCPs, user manuals, MDCG guidance, regulations and standards. Results link to their MD Atlas page. Sign in with your MD Atlas account.
defaultPrompt: List the MDR certificates of Medtronic that expire before 2027 and name the notified body.
Which German manufacturers does this authorised representative represent?
Find the SSCP for this device.

positive.description: Find a manufacturer and open its record
positive.prompt: Find the medical-device manufacturer B. Braun in Germany and show its registration details.
positive.expected_behavior: Searches companies with a German country filter, then fetches the matching B. Braun record and summarises its role, SRN, address and status with a link to its MD Atlas page.

positive.prompt: List the EU certificates held by Medtronic and the notified body for each.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds a Medtronic manufacturer entry, lists its certificates with type, number, status, expiry date and issuing notified body.

positive.description: Find a company's declared regulatory contacts
positive.prompt: Who is the person responsible for regulatory compliance (PRRC) at Siemens Healthineers?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Siemens Healthineers company entry and lists the people it declares, identifying the PRRC role.

positive.description: Look up a device model and its variants
positive.prompt: Find Accu-Chek devices and show the device model with its variants.
positive.expected_behavior: Searches devices by trade name, takes the Basic UDI-DI of a result and returns the device model with its risk class, manufacturer and variant list.

positive.prompt: Find MDCG guidance documents about clinical evaluation.
positive.expected_behavior: Searches guidance documents and lists matching MDCG documents with their reference, publishing body and a link to the original document.

negative.description: Medical advice is out of scope
negative.prompt: What dose of ibuprofen should I take for back pain?
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call MD Atlas. The question is medical advice, not EU medical-device market data.

negative.description: US FDA data is not covered
negative.prompt: Show me the FDA 510(k) clearance for the Dexcom G7.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not present MD Atlas results as FDA data. Explains that MD Atlas covers EU regulatory registrations, not FDA clearances, and may offer to look up the device's EU registration instead.

negative.prompt: Register my new device in EUDAMED for me.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call a tool to act. Explains that MD Atlas is read-only and cannot register devices.

publication.release_notes: First public release: nine read-only tools to search international medical-device companies, people, devices, certificates, regulatory documents and UDI codes.
